title: Chemical Equilibrium Mindmap
notes: Study of chemical equilibrium - dynamic state where forward and reverse reactions occur at equal rates.
Covers equilibrium constants, Le Chatelier's principle, and applications.
Essential for understanding reaction yields and industrial processes.

subtopics.name: Chemical
points: Forward rate = reverse rate, dynamic, closed system

subtopics.name: Concentration
points: Add reactant → forward, add product → reverse

subtopics.name: Q
points: Same form as K, any point in reaction

subtopics.name: Q vs K
points: Q<K: forward, Q=K: equilibrium, Q>K: reverse
